rounds.q: How many hours a day does the average American (15+) sleep, naps included?
rounds.why: Americans sleep about 9.7 hours on weekends and holidays, versus 8.8 on weekdays.
rounds.src: US BLS, American Time Use Survey (2025)
rounds.fun: Weekends are basically the national snooze button!

rounds.q: About how many hours a day does the average American (15+) watch TV?
rounds.why: It's 2.6 hours, half of all leisure time. On weekends it rises to 3.3.
rounds.fun: The couch keeps its own attendance record, and it's very proud of us.

rounds.q: What % of US households are just one person?
rounds.why: Back in 1974, only 19% of US households were one person.
rounds.fun: Up from 19% in 1974 to 29% now. Table for one, please!

rounds.q: What % of the world's people are left-handed?
rounds.why: About 9% more are mixed-handed, using different hands for different tasks.
rounds.fun: 11% lefties plus about 9% mixed-handed. That's about 1 in 5 who aren't all right!

rounds.q: What % of EU adults can chat in a second language?
rounds.fun: Among Europeans 15 to 24, it's 79%. Bonjour, hola, hallo!
